# [vDOM] <Transition mode="out-in"> throws error on synchronous done() call in leave hook (issue #15727)

### Vue version

3.5.43 (also tested on rc.10)

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#__PROD__

### Steps to reproduce

### Minimal Reproduction Code
_(Also available in the playground link above)_
```js
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const show = ref(true)

const handleLeave = (el, done) => {
  // Synchronous done() call triggers the vDOM error on out-in transitions
  done()
}
</script>

<template>
  <button @click="show = !show">Toggle</button>

  <Transition mode="out-in" @leave="handleLeave">
    <div v-if="show" key="a">A</div>
    <div v-else key="b">B</div>
  </Transition>
</template>
```

### What is expected?

Transition takes place

### What is actually happening?

TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'parentNode')

As a result, the component gets stuck with an empty view and an incorrect transition phase.

### Any additional comments?

Vapor mode handles this scenario correctly without throwing. Furthermore, deferring done to a microtask (queueMicrotask(done)) also avoids the crash.
